title: Use Premiere's own tool first
text: Use Premiere's own tool first: blur = my own adjustment layer + Gaussian Blur + an Ellipse or Rectangle mask, feathered. "No API" means: try the UI route. It doesn't mean impossible. A workaround is the last way, and the handover names it.
